title: National Palace of Culture
geometryBasis: Native OpenStreetMap outlines and named building parts, published operator structural envelope and existing public-domain Qualla photo of the north entrance and west side.
sectionBasis: The main volume rises above a low continuous plinth and several lower polygonal wings. Dark glazing alternates with pale deep pilasters. Bronze decoration is indicated only by its mounting panel.
limitations: The model includes the principal palace. The detached landscape, fountains, plaza monuments and underground facilities sit outside the model scope.
Glazing subdivisions and the secondary elevations are approximated where the confirmed photo is incomplete. The original sculpture on the entrance panel is omitted.
